one_shot_fence: repo workflow history (all pages); any prior non-skipped run blocks, including cancelled/failed/unknown; concurrency group; exact pin; run_attempt=1; local exclusive intent before PUT
remote_mutation_cas: UNVERIFIED; no claim of atomic GET-to-PUT CAS or exactly-once network delivery
public_settings: pre/post GET disabled; no subdomain mutation endpoint; no Wrangler

postcheck_evidence_limits.routes_custom_domains: OWNER EVIDENCE; API unverified without additional permissions
postcheck_evidence_limits.response_503: fixed code SHA plus offline execution; remote HTTP invocation prohibited
postcheck_evidence_limits.d1_database_name: config provenance only; binding API ID exact; no D1 inventory/query
postcheck_evidence_limits.queue_external_consumers: UNVERIFIED; no queue permission; candidate contains no queue bindings/handler

stop_after_put: any postcheck failure or missing evidence
after_put: one GET-only reconciliation; then STOP and owner revoke Worker Token plus delete GitHub Secret; never automatic redeploy/rollback

rollback.route: separately approve deployment of retained previous version; verify old version still exists read-only first; then verify restore snapshot and public disabled; no delete/recreate
rollback.code_source_backup: not stored; restore depends on retained Cloudflare version
rollback.remote_restore_availability: UNVERIFIED until fresh GET of retained version; do not promise executable rollback
